Class DelayRecipients

java.lang.Object
ecmwf.ecpds.master.plugin.http.controller.monitoring.DelayRecipients
public final class DelayRecipients extends Object
ECMWF Product Data Store (OpenECPDS) Project Works out who is concerned by a delay: the destinations receiving a (product, cycle) combination, using the same data as the destinations table at the bottom of /do/monitoring, and their contact emails.
Since:

      public static Map<String, TreeSet<String>> cyclesPerProduct() throws Exception
      Gets the available cycles for each product, from the monitoring data.
      Returns:
      the sorted cycles, keyed by product name
      Throws:
      Exception - if the monitoring data cannot be read

    • minutesBeforeSchedulePerProduct

      public static Map<String,Long> minutesBeforeSchedulePerProduct() throws Exception
      Finds the nearest schedule time across all known cycles for each product. A negative value means that at least one cycle is already late; cycles without a schedule are ignored.
      Returns:
      shortest minutes before schedule, keyed by product name
      Throws:
      Exception - if the monitoring data cannot be read
